dataset: PhysioNet MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database (DS2 Strict) + MIT-BIH Noise Stress Test Database (NSTDB)

noise_sources.bw: PhysioNet NSTDB / bw (Baseline Wander, 650,000 samples @ 360 Hz)
noise_sources.ma: PhysioNet NSTDB / ma (Muscle Artifact, 650,000 samples @ 360 Hz)
noise_sources.em: PhysioNet NSTDB / em (Electrode Motion, 650,000 samples @ 360 Hz)

calibration_policy: Development-calibrated Temperature Scaling (T=0.6399) + Selective Classification threshold (tau=0.9073)

headline_findings.h1_morphology_vs_intervals: Hybrid CNN significantly outperforms Waveform-only CNN (Macro F1 0.57 vs 0.30 on clean test).
headline_findings.h2_noise_sensitivity: Electrode Motion (em) causes the most severe degradation in V-Recall and highest prediction flip rates.
headline_findings.h3_abstention_effect: Applying calibrated abstention filters out high-entropy predictions under severe noise, maintaining lower selective risk at the cost of coverage.
